title: KAN Development | Careers
heading: Careers
text:
KAN is not 3D renders, construction cranes, or square meters. KAN is people who create symbols of Kyiv, where you want more: to live, to be, to do.

Since 2001, we have created 25,000 jobs. Currently, our team, together with partners, consists of 5,000 employees united by shared values and an unwavering principle regarding the quality of our projects.
